note: A small gravel-and-grass pull-off on the south side of Jerry Road, right at the road edge and in plain view of passing traffic; imagery shows an apron about 25 m wide and 15 m deep. DCNR sizes it for 'one small camper trailer' and grades the site moderate: the ground climbs away from the road at roughly 8 percent, so leveling takes some work, and the grass part may be soft when wet. Back-in. Jerry Road is gravel, 1 mile from US 30. An intermittent stream runs about 150 ft away across the road. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online (5 of 14 nights reserved in the November 2026 window), Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 40 ft, back-in, grass driveway, site grade Moderate. Fees confirmed and the $6.50 reservation fee added; booking, hookups, season confirmed; pull_through set false; toilets/water written as none. Imagery (leaf-off): roadside apron about 15 m north-west of the pin (inside the 30 m tolerance, pin not moved). USGS 3DEP: about 2.5 m of rise over the 30 m south of the road. Phone 717-485-3148 confirmed.
flags: Site text: 'Site is a gravel and grass parking lot that can hold 1 small camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents. Easy access but visible from the roadway. Located 150 feet from stream.' 'Small' is not a length and the page lists RV Site with a 40-ft maximum, so no drop proposed. Moderate site grade and grass are caveats in the note.
Waterfront: no lead. The agency puts the stream 150 ft away; NHD has an unnamed intermittent flowline (fcode 46003) 57 m from the pin, on the far side of Jerry Road. 'not waterfront' stands.
